title: A Dataset for the Detection of Dehumanizing Language

bias_targets.methodology: Extraction of conversational text using religious group keywords and human/model classification of targeted dehumanizing language patterns, such as negative evaluation and objectification.
Extraction of text using racial, ethnic, and nationality keywords, accompanied by an analysis of word2vec embedding similarities between these demographic identifiers and animal metaphors.

bias_targets.target: Sexual orientation and Gender identity bias
bias_targets.methodology: Extraction of text using LGBTQ+ related keywords and analyzing word2vec embedding similarities between these identifiers and terms associated with moral disgust.
